articles.summary: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is the most abundant modification in eukaryotic mRNA and can influence gene expression, but the molecular mechanisms by which it does this at an individual gene level are poorly understood. The eukaryote with the highest known percentage of adenosine in its RNA is P. falciparum, causative agent of the deadliest form of malaria. P. falciparum has a high genomic AT content (>80% A+T) and a particular A bias in mRNA - coding strands have an average adenosine content of 44%.

articles.title: Fauci adviser David Morens indicted on charges of concealing emails, avoiding records requests

articles.title: STAT+: Zap in a cap: How one neurotech startup is using a hat to treat depression

articles.chinese_summary: Oruka Therapeutics公布其中期研究结果，其长效注射疗法使63%的斑块状银屑病患者实现皮肤完全清除。该长效生物制剂展示了创新药在自身免疫疾病治疗中的潜力，可能改变现有治疗模式。

articles.title: STAT+: Astellas retries XLMTM gene therapy after deaths

articles.chinese_summary: 安斯泰来重启XLMTM基因疗法临床试验，该疗法曾因患者死亡事件中止。文章聚焦基因治疗领域的安全性与监管进展，涉及罕见病治疗创新，但对生物制造与大健康领域涉及有限。

articles.title: STAT+: Erasca touts strong, though preliminary, results in trial of pancreatic and lung cancer therapy

articles.title: Genetic Medicine Delivery Enhanced by Producer Cell Modifications

A new platform based on genome-wide screening systemically identifies which genes drive or block particle assembly to engineer cells that yield more potent delivery vehicles.

articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过全基因组筛选系统识别调控颗粒组装的基因，改造生产细胞以增强基因药物递送载体效能。该平台技术显著提升病毒载体/纳米颗粒的生产效率，对基因治疗、细胞治疗等创新药的生物制造工艺具有重要推动作用。

articles.title: Monoclonal Antibodies: Unlocking Cost and Efficiency Gains in Downstream Processing

In this webinar, our speaker will explore a series of practical, chromatography-focused strategies designed to enhance mAb purification performance while reducing cost of goods (COGs).

articles.chinese_summary: 本次网络研讨会探讨了通过色谱策略优化单克隆抗体纯化工艺，旨在提高下游加工效率并降低生产成本。内容聚焦生物制造过程中的关键技术改进，对生物制药工艺优化具有直接参考价值。

articles.title: Anticancer Strategy Targets Defense Mechanism in Senescent Cells
articles.summary:
Researchers identified GPX4 inhibitor drugs that target a defense mechanism in senescent cells, and which could lead to new treatments for cancer and age-associated diseases.

articles.chinese_summary: 研究人员发现GPX4抑制剂可靶向衰老细胞的防御机制，这一抗癌策略有望开发出治疗癌症和年龄相关疾病的新疗法。该研究通过靶向细胞衰老机制，为创新药物开发提供了新方向。

articles.title: Retron-Powered Approach Enables Genome Editing Across Diverse Bacterial Species
articles.summary:
By adapting a retron-based editing system from E. coli to 15 bacterial species, scientists reveal a genome editing platform that could accelerate studies of pathogens, microbial interactions, and engineered bacteria used in manufacturing.
The post Retron-Powered Approach Enables Genome Editing Across Diverse Bacterial Species appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 研究人员通过将基于逆转录子的编辑系统从大肠杆菌扩展到15种细菌物种，开发出一种新型基因组编辑平台。该技术可加速病原体研究、微生物相互作用分析，以及在生物制造中使用的工程菌开发，为合成生物学和生物工艺优化提供重要工具。

articles.title: A chemistry lab that runs itself to find the perfect reaction

articles.title: With ultrasound on a chip, Butterfly Network aims for global reach

articles.title: 4 studies to know from HRS 2026

articles.title: What happened to Covid?

articles.title: NIH-funded research lags in reporting sex differences, new study finds

articles.title: STAT+: Veradermics’ hair loss drug succeeds in late-stage trial

articles.title: STAT+: An insider reveals the real goals of prior authorization

articles.title: New U.S. recommendation on hepatitis B vaccine will have dire consequences, studies project

articles.title: Abdominal Contractions May Drive Brain Fluid Flow, Aiding in Neural Waste Clearance
articles.summary:
Data from mice and computer simulations suggest that abdominal contractions act like a pump to influence brain movement and cerebrospinal fluid dynamics, potentially aiding harmful neural waste clearance.

articles.chinese_summary: 研究显示小鼠腹部收缩可能像泵一样驱动脑脊液流动，促进神经废物清除。这一发现揭示了身体运动与大脑清洁机制的新联系，对理解神经退行性疾病和公共健康具有重要意义。

articles.title: Triplex formation drives noncontiguous VIPR RNA-guided DNA recognition
articles.summary: Viral Interference Programmable Repeat (VIPR) systems use a noncontiguous code for RNA-guided transcriptional silencing. How the Vipr protein and a vrRNA comprising alternating GGY and NN segments achieve precise DNA targeting is unknown. Here we present 21 cryo-electron microscopy structures that span the VIPR assembly pathway. Vipr protomers oligomerize along the vrRNA to form a right-handed helical filament, sequestering each GGY motif and positioning the adjacent NN bases for target base pai
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过冷冻电镜揭示了VIPR系统利用非连续RNA编码实现DNA靶向识别的分子机制。VIPR蛋白与vrRNA形成右手螺旋丝状结构，通过三重螺旋形成驱动DNA识别。这一发现对开发新型基因编辑和基因沉默工具具有重要启示，为创新基因疗法提供了潜在技术平台。

articles.title: Structural characterization of ribosome recycling and fusidic acid inhibition in Staphylococcus aureus

The antibiotic fusidic acid (FA) inhibits elongation and ribosome recycling by locking EF-G to the ribosome. Yet, no functional ribosome recycling FA complex has been successfully captured. Here we used single-particle cryo-electron microscopy to resolve multiple FA-stalled intermediates of Staphylococcus aureus ribosomes, including a previously unobserved
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过冷冻电镜解析金黄色葡萄球菌核糖体在褐霉酸抑制下的回收中间态结构，首次捕获了功能性核糖体回收-抗生素复合体。该工作揭示了抗生素通过锁定延伸因子EF-G来阻断细菌蛋白质合成的分子机制，为开发新型抗菌药物提供了结构基础。

articles.title: J&J to acquire Atraverse Medical

articles.title: RNF25 is activated as a response to amino acid starvation-induced ribosome collisions in competition with GCN2

Here, we show that not only ribosome-stalling by low doses of translation inhibitors, but also amino acid starvation induces RPS27A/eS31 ubiquitination, identifying a natural trigger of RNF25 activation. articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示RNF25通过响应氨基酸饥饿诱导的核糖体碰撞而被激活，与GCN2竞争。该机制涉及RPS27A/eS31的泛素化，属于核糖体相关质量控制通路，虽为基础研究，但对理解细胞应激反应有重要意义。

articles.title: Telomere-to-Telomere Assembly Using HERRO-Corrected Simplex Nanopore Reads
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 27 April 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10563-yTelomere-to-Telomere Assembly Using HERRO-Corrected Simplex Nanopore Reads
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了HERRO校正方法结合单链纳米孔测序数据，实现了端粒到端粒的完整基因组组装。该技术主要属于基础研究方法学突破，虽与创新药开发和大健康领域的基因组研究间接相关，但更侧重于测序技术和生物信息学工具的创新。

articles.title: Mechanism of nucleolytic degradation of human ribosomes
articles.summary: Stresses like starvation trigger degradation of mature 40S ribosomes, requiring the coordinated breakdown of large and stable RNA-protein complexes. The atypical kinase RIOK3 orchestrates degradation by binding ubiquitylated 40S ribosomes and promoting rRNA decay. However, the mechanisms and factors that mediate rRNA decay remain unknown. Here we find that in response to starvation, RIOK3 recruits the terminal uridylyl- transferase TUT7 and the exonuclease DIS3L2 to 40S ribosomes. Sequencing ana
articles.chinese_summary: 研究揭示了饥饿应激下人类40S核糖体降解机制。发现非典型激酶RIOK3通过招募末端尿苷酸转移酶TUT7和外切酶DIS3L2介导rRNA降解，阐明了稳定RNA-蛋白质复合物的协同分解过程，为细胞应激反应提供了新见解。

articles.title: What’s the true risk for eating disorders with GLP-1s?
articles.summary: The state of Covid-19 in 2026, a hat to treat depression, and other health news from Morning Rounds
articles.chinese_summary: 文章探讨GLP-1类药物与进食障碍的潜在风险关联，涉及药物安全性及心理健康议题。虽提及医疗健康领域，但与创新药研发、生物制造技术相关性较弱，主要聚焦于公共卫生和临床用药安全方面。

articles.title: Trump administration warns against using federal dollars on fentanyl test strips
articles.summary: The Trump administration underlines a “clear shift away from harm reduction and practices” that it says facilitates illegal drug use.
articles.chinese_summary: 特朗普政府警告禁止使用联邦资金购买芬太尼检测试纸，认为这助长非法药物使用。该政策标志着从减少伤害策略的明显转变，涉及公共卫生与药物政策争议。

articles.title: Supreme Court grapples with multibillion-dollar wave of lawsuits over Roundup cancer claims
articles.summary: The Supreme Court seemed divided Monday over whether to block thousands of lawsuits alleging the maker of the weedkiller Roundup failed to warn people it could cause cancer.
articles.chinese_summary: 美国最高法院审理Roundup除草剂致癌诉讼案，涉及数千起指控孟山都未能警示产品致癌风险的案件。该案虽不直接涉及创新药或生物制造技术，但对公共健康监管和产品安全警示制度具有重要影响。

articles.title: A Noncontiguous Code for RNA-Guided DNA Recognition Preceded CRISPR
articles.summary: CRISPR-Cas systems use RNA-guided proteins for adaptive immunity through a mechanism whose origin is unknown. Here we report the discovery of Viral Interference Programmable Repeat (VIPR) systems consisting of a Vipr protein more ancient than CRISPR-Cas and vrRNAs comprising alternating GGY/NN motifs. Unlike canonical guide RNAs that base pair with nucleic acid targets using an uninterrupted sequence, vrRNAs recognize double-stranded DNA through a noncontiguous code in which the variable NNs of
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究报道早于CRISPR的VIPR系统，揭示RNA通过非连续编码模式识别DNA的古老机制。虽涉及基因靶向原理，但属于基础生物学发现，与创新药/生物制造的直接关联较弱，主要推动对基因编辑工具进化起源的理解。

articles.title: Mitochondria can spawn new ‘organelles’ — hinting at how modern cells evolved
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 27 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01295-0Discovery bolsters theory that ancient mitochondria formed brand-new, specialized ‘sacs’ in cells by shedding their outer membranes.
articles.chinese_summary: 研究发现线粒体通过脱落外膜形成新的细胞器，支持了古代线粒体在细胞进化中创造新型细胞器的理论。该发现对理解细胞器起源和进化机制具有重要科学意义，但与创新药、生物制造及大健康领域的直接应用关联有限。

articles.title: Could agentic AI topple grant-funding systems?
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 27 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01297-yFunders must take action before an increase in submission of high-quality proposals written using AI models makes it impossible to sort the wheat from the chaff.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨AI生成的高质量项目申请书可能对科研资助体系造成的冲击，指出资助机构需提前应对。内容聚焦科研管理机制而非具体生物医药技术，与创新药、生物制造等领域的直接关联有限。

articles.title: Medtronic reports data breach on corporate IT systems
articles.summary: The medtech company does not expect any material impact on its business or financial results, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
articles.chinese_summary: 美敦力公司披露其企业IT系统遭遇数据泄露事件，但向美国证交会提交的文件表明，预计不会对业务运营及财务业绩产生实质性影响。此事主要涉及医疗科技企业的网络安全问题。

articles.title: STAT+: Dems say RFK Jr. has a pattern of failing to answer their questions

articles.chinese_summary: 文章报道民主党对肯尼迪未能履行分享争议合同承诺的批评，涉及卫生部长履职问题。内容聚焦政治问责而非医药技术，与大健康领域的公共治理有微弱关联。

articles.title: ‘The job description is changing’: mathematician Terence Tao on the rise of AI
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 27 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01246-9The Fields medallist discusses how ever-evolving technology is transforming mathematicians’ work.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨人工智能如何改变数学家的工作方式，属于科技对学术研究影响的范畴。与生物医药领域的直接关联较弱，仅涉及AI作为潜在工具可能间接影响相关研究，但未具体讨论医药应用。

articles.title: Why cosmology is more than a theory
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 27 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01303-3A philosophical take on the history of the Universe that is inspiring but incomplete.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨宇宙学的哲学思考，回顾宇宙历史但被认为不完整。内容聚焦理论宇宙学，与生物医药领域的创新药、生物制造及大健康均无直接关联。

articles.title: #ScientistAtWork 2026: Nature seeks striking photographs that capture researchers at work
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 27 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01266-5Competition winners receive a cash prize and will see their images featured in Nature.

articles.title: StockWatch: Trump Order Lifts Psychedelic Drug Shares
articles.summary:
Among its provisions, the order directs the FDA to provide Commissioner’s National Priority Vouchers (CNPVs) to “appropriate” psychedelic drugs that were granted the agency’s Breakthrough Therapy designation and met the voucher program’s criteria.

articles.chinese_summary: 特朗普行政命令推动迷幻药股上涨，要求FDA向符合条件的迷幻药颁发优先审评券。这些药物需获得突破性疗法认定，此举可能加速创新迷幻药物的审批流程，属于创新药政策范畴。

articles.title: STAT+: Doctor, wife of acting U.S. attorney general appointed to NIH advisory council
articles.summary: An integrative medicine doctor who is the wife of the acting U.S. attorney general has been named as a member to one of the advisory councils that provides critical funding…
articles.chinese_summary: 美国代理司法部长妻子被任命为NIH咨询委员会成员，她是一名整合医学医生。该任命涉及政治背景，与创新药、生物制造直接关联度低，主要涉及大健康领域的医疗政策与公共健康治理层面。

articles.title: Entire NSF science advisory board fired by Trump administration
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 26 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01361-7Members of the National Science Board, which the US Congress founded in 1950, were given no explanation for their termination.
articles.chinese_summary: 特朗普政府解雇了美国国家科学基金会全体科学顾问委员会成员，该委员会成立于1950年。此事件涉及科研管理政策变动，但与创新药、生物制造及大健康领域无直接关联，仅间接影响科研资助环境。

articles.title: ProPER: Programmable, multiplexed detection of molecular proximities and RNA life-cycle stages in situ
articles.summary: Proximity detection methods facilitate contextual analysis of biomolecules by reporting their microenvironment, spatial organization and molecular interactions. To expand these detection capabilities towards highly sensitive, quantitative, and multiplexed interaction mapping, we introduce Proximity Primer Exchange Reaction (ProPER). ProPER is a novel ligation-free proximity extension and controlled DNA amplification strategy that enables spatially resolved in situ detection of molecular proximit
articles.chinese_summary: ProPER是一种新型无连接邻近检测技术，通过DNA扩增策略实现分子邻近性的原位检测。该技术具备高灵敏度、定量分析和多重检测能力，为研究生物分子空间组织及RNA生命周期提供了创新工具，在疾病机制研究和精准医疗领域具有应用潜力。

articles.title: Potent and Broad HIV-1 Neutralization by a Bispecific CD4-CD4i Fusion Protein based on Single-Domain CD4-D1 and X5 CD4i antibody
articles.summary: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection remains a global health threat. Although antiretroviral therapy (ART) has significantly transformed HIV into a manageable chronic disease, emergence of drug resistance to current ART is a continuing concern. Broadly neutralizing antibodies, as well as reagents containing both a soluble CD4 mimetic and an HIV co-receptor inhibitor, such as CD4-CD4i antibodies, are promising strategies for the prevention and treatment of HIV infection. We previously dev
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种基于单域CD4-D1和X5 CD4i抗体的双特异性CD4-CD4i融合蛋白，能有效中和多种HIV-1毒株。该创新生物制剂通过结合可溶性CD4模拟物和共受体抑制剂，为HIV预防和治疗提供了新策略，具有显著的中和广谱性和效力，属于创新药研发范畴。

articles.title: Opinion: The podcast telling the stories behind Ambien, Ozempic, EpiPens, and other game-changing drugs
articles.summary: “We're basically not using our body as directed,” says "Drug Story" host Thomas Goetz.
articles.chinese_summary: 该播客节目通过讲述安眠药Ambien、减肥药Ozempic、急救笔EpiPen等创新药物的研发故事，探讨了药物如何改变医疗实践。虽然不涉及技术细节，但对理解创新药的社会影响和开发历程具有重要价值，与大健康领域的医疗创新高度相关。

articles.title: Dredd-mediated cleavage of Kenny uncouples the IKK complex from selective autophagy to enable innate immunity
articles.summary: Selective autophagy restrains innate immune signalling to maintain tissue homeostasis, yet how this repression is rapidly relieved during infection remains unclear. Here, we show that under basal conditions the inhibitor of {kappa}B kinase {gamma} (IKK{gamma}) Kenny is sequestered at autophagosomes through Atg8 and the selective autophagy receptor Ref(2)P, thereby silencing Imd pathway activity. Bacterial infection disrupts this interaction, releasing the IKK complex to enable immune signalling.
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示果蝇中选择性自噬通过隔离IKKγ蛋白Kenny抑制先天免疫信号。细菌感染通过Dredd蛋白酶切割Kenny，解除自噬对IKK复合物的束缚，从而激活免疫通路。该机制研究为理解免疫调控提供新视角，但距离直接药物应用较远。

articles.title: Nancy Cox, a CDC veteran and a stalwart in global flu research, dies at 77
articles.summary: Nancy Cox, a CDC veteran who for decades was a global leader in influenza research, has died at 77.
articles.chinese_summary: 美国疾控中心资深专家Nancy Cox去世，享年77岁。她数十年间在全球流感研究领域担任领导角色，为公共卫生和传染病防控做出了重要贡献。

articles.title: Coordinated Temporal Dynamics of Glucocorticoid Receptor Binding and Chromatin Landscape Drive Transcriptional Regulation
articles.summary: Glucocorticoid receptor (GR) signaling elicits diverse transcriptional responses through dynamic and context-dependent interactions with chromatin. Here, we define a temporally resolved and mechanistically integrated framework for GR-mediated gene regulation. Time-resolved analyses identify three conserved classes of GR chromatin binding (sustained, transient, and late), distinguished by differences in motif strength, chromatin accessibility, and cofactors engagement. Early GR binding preferenti
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过时间分辨分析揭示了糖皮质激素受体（GR）与染色质相互作用的动态模式，识别了持续、瞬时和延迟三种GR结合类型。这些类型在基序强度、染色质可及性和辅因子结合方面存在差异，阐明了GR介导基因转录的时序调控机制，为理解激素信号转导提供了新框架。

articles.title: BAG6 and RNF126 promote the degradation of cytosolic misfolded proteins that contain buried degron motifs
articles.summary: Missense mutations account for the majority of catalogued human disease-associated variants, and many are predicted to destabilize proteins and promote their degradation. To characterize the pathways responsible for recognizing and clearing such variants, we employed a two-pronged approach to identify both quality control components mediating turnover of misfolded proteins and the sequence elements within their substrates that drive this process. Using a panel of unstable cytosolic missense vari
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示BAG6和RNF126在降解含有埋藏降解基序的胞质错误折叠蛋白中的作用机制。通过分析不稳定错义突变蛋白，发现了介导蛋白质降解的质量控制通路及其底物序列特征，为理解遗传病分子机制提供了新视角。

articles.title: A Genetic Method for Distinguishing Cryptic Pocillopora Species in French Polynesia without Sequencing
articles.summary: Pocillopora is a widespread, dominant reef-building coral genus in the Indo-Pacific that exhibits high morphological similarity and plasticity. Given this, genetic tools are needed to robustly identify Pocillopora individuals to the species level. Quick and accurate identification approaches for Pocillopora species are critical to estimating biodiversity patterns under current and future environmental challenges. In recent years, the mitochondrial open reading frame (mtORF) and a histone region
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种无需基因测序即可鉴别法属波利尼西亚隐种 Pocillopora 珊瑚的遗传方法。通过线粒体开放阅读框和组蛋白区域进行快速准确物种鉴定，对评估当前和未来环境挑战下的生物多样性模式具有重要意义。

articles.title: Author Correction: A µ-opioid receptor superagonist analgesic with minimal adverse effects
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 24 April 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10552-1Author Correction: A µ-opioid receptor superagonist analgesic with minimal adverse effects
articles.chinese_summary: 本文报道了一种新型μ-阿片受体超强激动剂镇痛药，具有最小不良反应。该研究属于创新药领域，通过开发高效低毒的镇痛药物，为解决阿片类药物成瘾和呼吸抑制等严重副作用提供了潜在突破性治疗方案。

articles.title: DCN1 inhibitor induces fetal hemoglobin through self-limited regulation of CUL3 neddylation
articles.summary: Few genetic loci are as well-characterized as the globin gene locus, and the substitution of healthy {gamma}-globin (HbF) for missing or mutated {beta}-globin (HbB) is an established therapeutic strategy for {beta}-hemoglobinopathies including sickle cell disease (SCD) and {beta}-thalassemia. Although substantial progress has been made in understanding HbF derepression and globin switching, many current therapeutic strategies involving small molecules increase HbF through broad epigenetic pertur
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种DCN1抑制剂，通过调控CUL3蛋白的neddylation来诱导胎儿血红蛋白表达，为治疗β-血红蛋白病（如镰状细胞病和β-地中海贫血）提供了新的小分子治疗策略。该机制针对特异性调控血红蛋白转换，具有治疗创新药的潜力。

articles.title: Expanding the chemical diversity of RNA by transcriptional incorporation of amino acid- and glycosyl-modified nucleotides
articles.summary: With the increasing interest in RNA-based therapies, there is a pressing need to incorporate new chemis-tries into more complex RNA molecules. These modifications can protect RNA from degradation, improve its pharmacokinetics, and enhance its targeting properties. Here we describe the enzymatic synthesis of chemically modified RNA derivatives using a mutant T7 RNA polymerase to incorporate 23 different base modifications alongside stabilizing ribose modifications, such as 2'-fluoro and 2'-deoxy
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过突变T7 RNA聚合酶，成功将23种碱基修饰及核糖稳定化修饰（如2'-氟、2'-脱氧）转录整合到RNA分子中。该技术能增强RNA的稳定性、改善药代动力学并提升靶向性，对基于RNA的疗法（如mRNA疫苗、RNA药物）的创新开发具有重要推动作用。

articles.title: Japanese Pharma Companies Turning to CDMOs Earlier in Product Life Cycle
articles.summary:
The bottleneck isn’t discovery anymore. It’s execution. In peptides, programs are running into challenges around analytical complexity, scaleup, and the availability of key raw materials such as protected amino acids.
The post Japanese Pharma Companies Turning to CDMOs Earlier in Product Life Cycle appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 日本制药企业正更早地在产品生命周期中转向CDMO合作。文章指出当前药物开发的瓶颈已从发现转向生产执行，特别是在肽类药物领域面临分析复杂性、工艺放大及关键原料供应等挑战，突显了生物制造环节在创新药开发中的关键作用。

articles.title: AI Learns to Predict Breast Cancer Risk from How Single Cells Respond to Pressure
articles.summary:
Researchers created a novel microfluidic platform, AI tool, and risk score that can assess women’s breast cancer risk at the cellular level, based on the how how breast cancer cells respond to being squeezed, and their “mechanical age.” 
The post AI Learns to Predict Breast Cancer Risk from How Single Cells Respond to Pressure appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 研究人员开发了一种结合微流控平台和AI工具的新方法，通过分析单个乳腺细胞在压力下的机械响应特征来评估乳腺癌风险。这项技术能够量化细胞的'机械年龄'，为精准医疗提供了创新的早期筛查手段，在大健康领域的疾病预防和个性化风险评估方面具有重要价值。

articles.title: Protein structure-informed deep learning enables species-specific codon optimization
articles.summary: Codon usage bias is highly species-specific, posing a major challenge for heterologous protein expression. Existing deep learning approaches to codon optimization rely primarily on DNA or protein sequence information and largely neglect constraints imposed by protein structure and folding. Here, we present Protein structure-Informed Species-specific Codon Optimization (PISCO), a Geometric Vector Perceptron (GVP)-based model that integrates protein sequence, three-dimensional protein structure, a
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了PISCO模型，通过整合蛋白质序列和三维结构信息进行物种特异性密码子优化。该方法解决了异源蛋白表达中的密码子使用偏好问题，显著提升了重组蛋白产量，对生物制造领域的蛋白质生产具有重要应用价值。

articles.title: CellChem: Cellular transcriptional responses reshape molecular representation space for efficient and multi-scale drug discovery
articles.summary: Despite decades of progress in computational drug discovery, deep learning-based molecular representation models remain largely structure-centric, assuming that chemical similarity approximates functional similarity. However, drug effects in cells are shaped not only by chemical similarity but also by molecular interactions in the cellular context. To capture this complexity, we introduce CellChem, a cellular-chemical representation-learning framework that learns cell-guided molecular representa
articles.chinese_summary: CellChem提出细胞化学表征学习框架，通过整合细胞转录反应与分子结构数据，突破传统结构中心模型的局限。该方法能更准确预测药物功能效应，显著提升多尺度药物发现效率，对创新药开发具有重要价值。

articles.title: Decoding Smell from Receptor Structure
articles.summary: Olfaction enables animals to detect and discriminate a vast array of chemicals, yet how odorant receptors (ORs) encode ligand selectivity remains unclear. Although recent advances in protein structure prediction have expanded access to OR structures, linking these to function at scale has been challenging. Here, we combined AlphaFold3-predicted receptor structures with protein language model embeddings and in vivo pS6-IP-Seq measurements of olfactory sensory neuron activation across a chemically
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究结合AlphaFold3预测的嗅觉受体结构与蛋白语言模型，系统解析气味分子识别机制。该成果对创新药研发具有重要意义，为靶向GPCR受体的药物设计提供了新范式，尤其在神经系统疾病治疗靶点发现方面具有潜在应用价值。

articles.title: Opinion: The local news crisis is also a public health crisis
articles.summary: Health and science reporting is often treated as optional coverage. It is anything but.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨地方新闻危机如何演变为公共卫生危机，强调健康与科学报道的必要性。虽然不直接涉及创新药或生物制造技术，但指出了科学信息传播对公众健康决策的重要性，与大健康领域的公共卫生和科学传播高度相关。

articles.title: STAT+: Sanofi MS drug gets positive review in Europe following FDA
articles.summary: A multiple sclerosis drug from Sanofi that was rejected late last year by the FDA found a warmer reception in Europe.
articles.chinese_summary: 赛诺菲多发性硬化症药物在去年遭FDA拒绝后，获得欧洲监管机构的积极评价。该案例体现了创新药在不同监管体系下的审批差异，属于中枢神经系统疾病治疗领域的重要进展。

articles.title: International childhood vaccine campaign grows

articles.chinese_summary: 本文讨论AACR会议发布的癌症研究进展，包括AI在肿瘤学中的应用、CRISPR技术筛选HIV感染相关基因、肝脏组织工程以及制药行业商业动态。内容主要聚焦创新疗法开发与技术突破，与大健康和生物制造领域关联较弱。

articles.title: One Biosciences Chooses Albany, NY, as Its U.S. Location
articles.summary:
Officials at One Biosciences say the company will bring its technology to the Albany hub to address the unmet clinical and scientific needs to characterize the tumor ecosystem via a single-cell profiling approach. 
The post One Biosciences Chooses Albany, NY, as Its U.S. Location appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: One Biosciences选择纽约州奥尔巴尼作为美国基地，将利用单细胞分析技术解析肿瘤生态系统。该技术通过表征肿瘤微环境，有望推动精准医疗发展，满足未满足的临床需求，与创新药研发和大健康领域高度相关。

articles.title: Single-Cell Atlas of the Prenatal Brain Reveals How Down Syndrome Reshapes Development
articles.summary:
A cellular-resolution map of prenatal brain development in Down syndrome has been developed, revealing disrupted neuron production timing, altered cell types, and shared mechanisms with other disorders. 
The post Single-Cell Atlas of the Prenatal Brain Reveals How Down Syndrome Reshapes Development appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过构建唐氏综合征产前大脑的单细胞图谱，揭示了神经元生成时序紊乱及细胞类型改变等发育异常机制。该发现为理解神经发育障碍提供了重要见解，对精准医疗和先天性疾病预防具有潜在价值，但距直接药物开发仍有距离。

articles.title: Genetic compensation in β-actin mutants occurs independently of mutations that destabilize β-actin mRNA
articles.summary: Proper maintenance of gene expression in response to mutations or environmental fluctuations is critical for cell development and survival. Recently, a novel genetic compensation mechanism was described wherein mutant mRNA decay triggers increased transcription of paralogous genes. This effect was reported for several genes, including {beta}-actin (Actb) in mouse embryonic stem cells, where Actb mRNA with a premature termination codon enhances transcription of its paralog, {gamma}-actin (Actg1),
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示了β-肌动蛋白突变体中通过mRNA降解触发同源基因γ-肌动蛋白转录增强的新型遗传补偿机制。该发现阐明了细胞应对基因突变的分子调控网络，为理解基因治疗中潜在补偿效应和开发靶向mRNA稳定性的创新疗法提供了理论基础。

articles.title: Transcriptomic Profiling of Thyroid Eye Disease Orbital Fibroblasts Identifies Sorafenib as a Novel Therapeutic
articles.summary: Thyroid eye disease (TED) is a debilitating condition characterized by orbital fibroblast (OF) activation and excessive hyaluronic acid (HA) accumulation within the retro-ocular space. While IGF-1R blockade with teprotumumab has significantly advanced TED management, incomplete clinical responses and disease relapse underscore the need to identify alternative targets. In this study, we used high-throughput RNA sequencing to map the transcriptomic landscape in TED OFs compared with non-TED OF con
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过转录组分析甲状腺眼病眼眶成纤维细胞，发现索拉非尼可作为潜在治疗药物。虽然不涉及全新药物开发，但通过药物重定位策略为罕见病提供了创新治疗方案，符合创新药领域的药物发现范畴。

articles.title: Sex differences in cardiomyocyte proteomic responses to the cardiotoxic chemotherapy drug doxorubicin
articles.summary: Anthracyclines, including doxorubicin, are widely used chemotherapeutic agents, but dose-dependent cardiotoxicity limits their clinical utility and increases the risk of heart failure in cancer survivors. In paediatric patients, female sex is a significant risk factor for anthracycline-associated cardiotoxicity, yet pre-clinical studies rarely investigate sex differences in immature hearts. Here, we provide a proteomic dataset from primary cardiomyocytes, isolated from postnatal day 2 rat hearts
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过蛋白质组学分析揭示了新生大鼠心肌细胞对阿霉素心脏毒性的性别差异，为理解儿科患者中女性更高心脏毒性风险提供了机制见解。该发现对肿瘤幸存者的长期健康管理及精准医疗具有重要价值，但与大健康和精准医学的相关性高于创新药或生物制造。

articles.title: An RNA-centric interactomics screen identifies novel proviral and antiviral genome binding interactors for tick-borne encephalitis virus
articles.summary: The tick-borne encephalitis virus (TBEV), which belongs to the Orthoflavivirus genus, is a medically significant arbovirus in Europe and Asia. Despite distinct pathobiological outcomes, arboviruses have evolved specific strategies to co-opt cellular factors for replication and immune evasion, that involve both viral proteins and viral RNA. The RNA genome of TBEV, as both the substrate for genome replication and translation and a designated target for innate antiviral immunity, is a nexus for int
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过RNA中心互作组学筛选，发现蜱传脑炎病毒基因组的新型前病毒和抗病毒结合因子。该工作揭示了病毒RNA如何劫持宿主因子进行复制与免疫逃逸，为开发针对RNA病毒的新型抗病毒策略提供了潜在靶点，对创新药物研发具有重要启示。

articles.title: Inside the evidence revolution — how decision-making became data driven
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 24 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01359-1Nature's Helen Pearson joins us to talk about her book Beyond Belief.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨医疗决策如何转向数据驱动模式，聚焦证据革命在健康领域的应用。虽然不直接涉及具体疗法技术，但对大健康领域的临床实践、精准医疗和公共卫生决策具有重要参考价值，体现了数据科学对医疗体系的影响。

articles.title: Daily briefing: The heart’s pumping motion seems to keep cancer at bay
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 24 April 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01363-5Hearts that didn’t beat were quickly overtaken by cancer cells in mice. Plus, huge octopuses might have ruled the ancient seas and how geopolitics is affecting huge health data sets.
articles.chinese_summary: 研究发现心脏搏动可能抑制癌症发展：在小鼠实验中，停止跳动的心脏迅速被癌细胞侵袭。该研究揭示了心脏机械运动与肿瘤抑制的新机制，为理解癌症发生及心血管健康与疾病关联提供了新视角。

articles.title: PABPC1 Modulates Immunoglobulin pre-mRNA Alternative Polyadenylation
articles.summary: Alternative polyadenylation is a mechanism by which cells tune gene expression, and dysregulation can lead to development of disease. PABPC1 has been implicated in poly(A) site selection, but its function in gene regulation remains contradictory and poorly defined. Here, we investigate its role in B cell development, where APA controls immunoglobulin secretion. To define this role, we mapped PABPC1-RNA interactions using CLAP-seq and perturbed PABPC1 expression using a degron based strategy. PAB
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究探讨PABPC1在B细胞发育中通过调控免疫球蛋白前体mRNA选择性多聚腺苷酸化来影响基因表达的机制。虽然不直接涉及创新药或生物制造技术，但对理解抗体产生和免疫调节具有基础科学价值，可能间接影响大健康领域的精准医疗和疾病机制研究。

articles.title: Long-lived mammals contain more phosphorylation sites in the SIRT6 C-terminus that enhance PARP1 interaction and resistance to oxidative stress
articles.summary: Sirtuin 6 (SIRT6) is a protein deacetylase and ribosyltransferase that is a vital hub for maintaining epigenetic homeostasis, regulating the transcriptome, and repairing DNA double stranded breaks (DSBs). Comprehensive proteomic profiling of the SIRT6 post-translational landscape, however, remains elusive. The SIRT6 C-terminal domain contains multiple phosphorylation sites. We find that the presence and use of these sites is strongly correlated with maximum lifespan across mammals. Subsequent bi
articles.chinese_summary: 研究发现长寿哺乳动物SIRT6蛋白C端含有更多磷酸化位点，这些位点增强与PARP1的相互作用及氧化应激抗性。该机制揭示了物种寿命差异的分子基础，为衰老研究和相关药物开发提供新靶点。

articles.title: STAT+: Utah medical board calls for immediate suspension of state’s AI doctor experiment

articles.title: Brain tissue near tumours is loaded with plastic

articles.title: Organic Germanium (Ge-132) reduces glycative damage while maintaining cellular stress signaling: evidence of functional dissociation
articles.summary: Organic germanium, particularly carboxyethyl germanium sesquioxide (Ge 132), has been investigated for decades in relation to diverse biological effects, with a strong emphasis on its antioxidant properties. However, the available literature remains dispersed, encompassing heterogeneous experimental models and endpoints that limit mechanistic interpretation. While antiglycative activity has been described at the biochemical level, its downstream gene regulatory consequences under glycative stres
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究探讨有机锗Ge-132在糖化应激条件下减少糖化损伤并维持细胞应激信号传导的作用机制。虽然涉及抗氧化和抗糖化活性，但主要聚焦于基础生物学机制，与创新药开发和大健康领域的抗衰老研究有潜在关联，但距离直接应用尚有距离。

articles.title: CRISPR Base Editing Repairs Hard-to-Treat Cystic Fibrosis Mutation in Cell Models
articles.summary:

articles.title: A CAR-T biotech’s dramatic turnaround, and drugmakers’ tactics to drive more scripts

articles.title: Heart’s Constant Beating Suppresses Tumor Growth in Cardiac Tissues
articles.summary:

articles.title: Isoform-specific cofactor recruitment through the intrinsically disordered N-terminus of p63 underlies differential transcriptional activities
articles.summary: The transcription factor p63 is critical for epithelial development and implicated in tumorigenesis. However, our understanding of the role of p63 in development and disease has been complicated by its diverse isoforms. As a member of the p53 family member of genes, TP63 encodes for numerous isoforms, including the N-terminal variants TAp63 and {triangleup}Np63, which are generated through alternative promoter usage. TAp63 and {triangleup}Np63 share various structural domains, including the DNA-
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示了转录因子p63不同亚型通过其内在无序N端结构域招募特异性辅因子，从而调控基因表达的分子机制。该发现深化了对p63在胚胎发育和肿瘤发生中功能的理解，为基础癌症生物学提供了新见解，但与创新药、生物制造及大健康的直接关联有限。

articles.title: The ABI5-WRKY45-LSU1 axis confers tolerance of Arabidopsis thaliana to cadmium
articles.summary: Abstract Abscisic acid (ABA) is involved in Cd tolerance in Arabidopsis, but the underlying mechanisms are unclear. In this study, we revealed that the ABI5-WRKY45-LSU1 axis confers the tolerance of Arabidopsis to Cd stress. Under Cd stress, the biosynthesis of ABA is increased, and the expression of transcription factor ABI5 is upregulated. Accordingly, the abi5-8 mutants show increased Cd sensitivity. ABI5 directly binds the ABRE element in the WRKY45 promoter to activate its transcription. Ov
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示了拟南芥中ABI5-WRKY45-LSU1信号轴调控镉胁迫耐受性的分子机制。研究发现镉胁迫会诱导ABA合成，上调转录因子ABI5表达，进而激活WRKY45转录，最终增强植物对重金属的耐受性。该研究属于基础植物生物学领域，与创新药、生物制造及大健康的直接关联性较低。

articles.title: Temporal persistence of vertebrate airborne environmental DNA in a natural open-air setting
articles.summary: Airborne environmental DNA (eDNA) is a promising tool for detecting a wide range of taxa including threatened and invasive species, yet its application in management is constrained by a limited understanding of its temporal persistence, particularly in nature. We investigated the temporal persistence of airborne eDNA in a natural outdoor setting, using Bennetts wallaby Notamacropus rufogriseus as a case study. We captured airborne eDNA from a single Bennetts wallaby carcass, deployed in an area
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究在自然户外环境中调查了脊椎动物空气传播环境DNA的时间持久性，以贝内特沙袋鼠为案例。研究发现空气eDNA可在开放环境中持续存在，为生物多样性监测提供了新方法，但与创新药、生物制造及大健康领域直接关联有限。

articles.title: STAT+: Kyverna Therapeutics plans to submit cell therapy for stiff person syndrome for FDA approval
articles.summary: A one-time cell therapy from Kyverna Therapeutics for stiff person syndrome, a rare disease, improved mobility and reduced disabilities in a late-stage trial.
articles.chinese_summary: Kyverna Therapeutics公司针对罕见病僵人综合征开发的细胞疗法在后期试验中取得积极结果，能显著改善患者活动能力并减轻残疾症状。该公司计划向FDA提交上市申请，这代表创新细胞疗法在自身免疫疾病领域的重要进展。

articles.title: STAT+: From Revolution Medicines, more strong data on KRAS drug and a glimpse of a ‘novel class’ beyond it

articles.title: Alzheimer’s Linked to Cancer Mutations in Brain Immune Cells

The brain’s resident immune cells, microglia, amass mutations in specific cancer-driving genes that don’t manifest as cancer, but instead may help drive Alzheimer’s disease, pointing to new potential therapeutic strategies.

articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过大规模平行报告实验，追溯并重写了哺乳动物发育增强子的进化轨迹。文章聚焦于顺式调控元件的功能演化机制，虽为基础研究，但对理解基因调控网络和进化医学具有潜在意义，与创新药开发的基因治疗等前沿领域存在间接关联。

articles.chinese_summary: 本研究聚焦组蛋白H4乙酰-甲基化修饰（Kacme），发现其广泛富集于开放染色质区域如启动子和增强子，揭示了该修饰在维持染色质可及性中的潜在作用。属于基础机制探索，与药物开发等应用领域关联较弱。

While the molecular details of LARP1 binding to the ribosome and to TOP mRNAs are deciphered, the mechanistic link between these two activities is not understood. articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示LARP1蛋白通过其RRM结构域作为核糖体响应性调节因子，调控编码核糖体蛋白的TOP mRNA。该机制阐明了核糖体结合与mRNA抑制间的分子联系，为理解核糖体合成失调相关疾病提供了基础科学依据，但对创新药、生物制造或大健康的直接应用有限。

articles.title: The vacuolar tauopathy-associated mutation D395G confers redox sensitivity to p97/VCP
articles.summary: The multifunctional AAA+ ATPase p97/VCP is a pivotal regulator of cellular proteostasis, extracting polyubiquitinated substrates from protein complexes or organelle membranes for proteasomal degradation. Mutations in p97 are linked to a broad spectrum of neurodegenerative disorders, including multisystem proteinopathy and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Here, we provide insights into the basis of dysfunction in p97D395G, implicated in vacuolar tauopathy, using an integrated structural approach. T
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究探讨了与空泡性tau蛋白病相关的p97/VCP蛋白D395G突变如何通过影响蛋白结构和功能导致神经退行性疾病。研究发现该突变使p97对氧化还原状态敏感，揭示了其在细胞蛋白稳态调控中的新机制，为理解神经退行性疾病的分子基础提供了重要线索。

PRC inhibitors show promise for various disorders, but use is limited because of pleiotropic PRC activities. Here, we combined laser-capture microdissection with high-throughput sequencing to perfor
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过激光捕获显微切割与高通量测序相结合，在活体噬菌体展示中实现微解剖区室分辨率分析。研究揭示了驱动肽序列选择的约束机制，为创新药物靶向配体的发现提供了新方法，对靶向给药系统开发具有重要价值。

articles.title: An integrated pipeline to count individual transcripts with single-cell resolution
articles.summary: Quantifying transcript abundance at single-cell resolution is important for understanding gene regulation in intact multicellular organisms. In Caenorhabditis elegans, RNA fluorescence in situ hybridization has been widely used to visualize transcripts, but conventional smFISH approaches can be limited by low signal-to-noise, poor performance with short transcripts, and workflows that do not readily support absolute transcript counting in identified cells. Here, we present an integrated experime
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种集成实验流程，能够在单细胞分辨率下精确计数单个转录本。该技术克服了传统smFISH方法的局限性，包括信噪比低、短转录本检测性能差等问题，为理解多细胞生物中的基因调控机制提供了重要工具。

articles.title: Chromatin association promotes UBR5-mediated degradation of Rb
articles.summary: The retinoblastoma protein Rb is a cell cycle inhibitor that plays a central role in regulating the G1/S cell cycle transition. Un-/hypo-phosphorylated Rb suppresses E2F transcription activity by binding to E2F/DP dimers and recruiting chromatin remodelers to prevent cells from entering S phase. articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示了染色质结合促进UBR5介导的Rb蛋白降解的新机制。作为细胞周期关键调控因子，Rb通过经典磷酸化途径和新发现的降解途径共同调控G1/S期转换。这一发现为开发靶向Rb降解的癌症治疗策略提供了新靶点，对肿瘤生物学领域具有重要创新意义。

articles.title: Mosquito-directed PROTACs to block malaria transmission

articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种靶向蚊子p38 MAPK的PROTAC分子NR-7h，通过诱导蛋白质降解阻断疟疾传播。该技术属于创新药物开发领域，利用蛋白降解技术干预寄生虫在蚊子体内的生命周期，为疟疾防控提供了新策略。

articles.title: In silico structural analysis of EthA substitutions for ranking priority mutations leading to ethionamide resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis
articles.summary: Background: Tuberculosis (TB) is the second-leading cause of deaths from infectious agents and remains a global health threat. Ethionamide (ETH) is a prodrug used in regimens for multidrug-resistant TB, and, partly due to side effects that can lead to low treatment adhesion, resistance arises. Changes in EthA, the monooxygenase that activates ETH, are the main mechanism of resistance. Yet, of hundreds of EthA substitutions found in resistant isolates, only a handful have been annotated as resist
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过计算机结构分析评估EthA蛋白突变与结核病药物乙硫异烟胺耐药性的关联。虽然聚焦于耐药机制这一基础研究领域，与创新药开发有一定间接关联，但与生物制造和大健康领域的直接相关性较低，主要属于学术研究范畴。

articles.title: Disturbed ATP and AMPK homeostasis in an AnkF377del mouse model for craniometaphyseal dysplasia
articles.summary: Craniometaphyseal dysplasia (CMD) is a rare genetic disorder characterized by hyperostosis of craniofacial bones and flared metaphyses of long bones. Mutations in ANKH (mouse orthologue ANK), a transmembrane protein mediating ATP and citrate efflux, cause the autosomal dominant form of CMD. How ANK mutations in CMD affect ATP/citrate homeostasis and downstream targets remains unknown. We determined that cellular ATP export, intracellular ATP levels, and plasma citric acid were significantly redu
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过AnkF377del小鼠模型探讨颅骨干骺端发育不良(CMD)的发病机制。研究发现ANKH基因突变导致细胞ATP外排减少、细胞内ATP水平降低及血浆柠檬酸下降，揭示了ATP/柠檬酸稳态失衡在骨骼发育异常中的作用机制，为理解罕见遗传病提供了新见解。

articles.title: Detecting misfolded non-covalent lasso entanglements in protein structures, simulation trajectories, and mass spectrometry data
articles.summary: A previously overlooked class of protein entanglements, non-covalent lasso entanglements (NCLEs), has been found to play a role in widespread protein misfolding. However, understanding the influence NCLEs have on biological processes is hindered by the absence of dedicated algorithms and computational tools to detect and characterize these geometries in protein structures, molecular dynamics simulations, and in comparison to experimental data from limited proteolysis (LiP) and cross-linking (XL)
articles.chinese_summary: 本文发现非共价套索缠结(NCLEs)是导致蛋白质错误折叠的新机制，并开发检测算法应用于结构分析、分子动力学模拟及质谱数据比对。该基础研究主要推动蛋白质折叠机制理解，与创新药开发间接相关，但距直接应用尚有距离。

articles.title: Evolution of the highest fidelity DNA replication systems
articles.summary: DNA mutation on average is deleterious, and evolution generally acts to reduce mutation rates to the limit of natural selection. The limit of natural selection is set by multiple factors, of which effective population size is only one. We consider a form of lethal mutagenesis as an upper bound to mutation rates for any organism, an argument that is congruent with a biophysical context, wherein random mutations are a form of entropy. In this analysis, coding genome size, body mass, generation tim
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨DNA复制系统的进化机制，分析突变率的上限及其与有效种群规模、基因组大小的关系。研究从生物物理角度将随机突变视为熵的形式，虽涉及生命系统基础机制，但与创新药、生物制造及大健康领域的直接应用关联较弱，主要贡献于基础生物学理论。

articles.title: PREFERENTIAL INVASION OF DIFFERENTIATED BLADDER CARCINOMA CELLS BY FLAGELLATED GROUP B2 ESCHERICHIA COLI
articles.summary: Phylogenetic group B2 Escherichia coli is associated with urinary tract infections and other pathologies, but the basis for this phylogenetic skew is not understood. One aspect of urinary tract infections is binding to and entering uroepithelial cells. To test whether a phylogenetic skew exists for cell invasion, we examined invasion of 10 E. coli strains from three phylogenetic groups into CRL2169 and HTB-9 cells, which are derived from grade 1 and grade 2 bladder carcinomas, respectively. The
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究探讨B2群大肠杆菌对不同分化程度膀胱癌细胞系的侵袭偏好性，揭示了该菌株与尿路感染的关联机制。研究聚焦于细菌入侵宿主细胞的生物学过程，虽涉及膀胱癌模型，但主要属于基础微生物致病机理研究，与创新药、生物制造及大健康领域的直接关联有限。

articles.title: Preservation of full-length transcripts at ambient temperature using ensilication
articles.summary: Long-read RNA sequencing can resolve full-length transcript isoforms directly from single molecules, but this capability is contingent on maintaining molecular integrity. Here we show that ensilication, the encapsulation of RNA within a deposited silica matrix, preserves isoform-level fidelity in PacBio Kinnex long-read sequencing after seven days of storage at 40 {degrees}C. Pooled human total RNA was profiled across six preservation conditions spanning cryogenic freezing, ensilication at ambie
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种ensilication技术，通过二氧化硅基质封装RNA，能在40°C环境下保存7天后仍保持全长转录本完整性。该技术对生物制造领域的样本储存、运输稳定性具有重要价值，可提升长链RNA测序数据的可靠性。

articles.title: The RNase and RNA binding activities of selected RNase R truncations and mutations plus a detailed step by step protocol to purify recombinant RNase R
articles.summary: RNase R is a processive 3' to 5' exoribonuclease that degrades a broad array of linear RNA species while preserving RNA lariats and circular RNAs (circRNA). In recent years, this enzyme has become pivotal for the field of circRNA research, serving as a key step for circRNA enrichment, purification, and identification. Despite this growing importance, the effects of mutations and truncations in RNase R have been incompletely studied. We make several point mutations and assay their effects on the
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过构建RNase R的截短体和点突变体，系统评估其RNase活性和RNA结合能力，并提供了详细的重组RNase R纯化方案。该酶在circRNA研究中具有关键作用，但突变影响尚未充分研究。工作主要聚焦于酶学机制和实验方法开发，与基础研究相关性较高。

articles.title: HIV and Cocaine exposure promote Tau phosphorylation through RSK-1 in a GSK3β-independent manner.
articles.summary: HIV and cocaine are known to disrupt neuronal signaling and contribute to neurocognitive dysfunction, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms are not clear. In this study, we delineate the underlying molecular mechanism by which HIV and or cocaine enhance Tau phosphorylation (p Tau S396), a marker of Tau mediated neuropathies. Furthermore, we elucidate how these two independent neuropathogenic factors, cocaine and HIV, exploit distinct yet convergent signaling pathways to drive this pathological
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示HIV与可卡因通过RSK-1通路独立于GSK3β促进Tau蛋白磷酸化的分子机制，探讨了这两种神经致病因子如何通过不同但汇聚的信号通路驱动tau介导的神经病变。研究聚焦神经认知障碍的分子基础，与神经退行性疾病机制相关。

articles.title: Distribution and p300/CBP dependency of cis-regulatory elements are encoded by unique combinations of histone lactylation and acetylation
articles.summary: Histone lactylation is a recently identified modification linked to metabolism. Genome-wide profiling has suggested that H3K18la marks tissue/cell type-specific enhancers in combination with H3K27ac; however, it remains unclear whether and how these modifications differ. Through a systematic comparison of histone mark distributions, we showed that H3K18la marks active enhancers irrespective of H3K27ac. Our analysis revealed that H3K18la predominantly localizes at non-promoter regions, and exhibi
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究系统比较组蛋白乳酸化修饰H3K18la与乙酰化修饰H3K27ac的分布特征，发现H3K18la独立标记活性增强子，其分布具有组织特异性且依赖p300/CBP调控。该基础研究揭示了代谢相关表观遗传标记在基因调控中的新机制，为理解代谢疾病相关基因表达提供理论依据。

articles.title: Temporal gating dictates stress-induced transcript export from the nucleus
articles.summary: Prior studies have largely focused on transcriptional and translational control during stress, but how regulated nuclear mRNA export contributes to the stress response remains unresolved. We show that nuclear mRNA export is progressively inhibited during arsenite and heat stress in human cells. In contrast to previous work largely in yeast that suggests nuclear export of stress-induced transcripts is prioritized through sequence-specific mechanisms, we demonstrate that temporal gating determines
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究揭示在应激条件下，人类细胞核内mRNA输出会逐渐受到抑制，并发现时间门控机制而非序列特异性机制主导应激诱导转录本的输出。该基础发现虽与基因治疗等创新药领域间接相关，但主要贡献于对基因表达调控机制的基础认知。

Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. The initial public offering (IPO) market showed signs of life for the first time in more than a month as Boston-based Avalyn Pharma filed a registration statement on Wednesday seeking to raise capital to develop its pipeline of respiratory disease treatments.
The post StockWatch: IPO Market Shows Sign of Life with Avalyn Filing appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 波士顿Avalyn制药公司提交IPO申请，拟融资开发呼吸系统疾病治疗管线，标志着IPO市场一个多月来首次复苏。该公司专注于创新疗法开发，但文章未具体说明技术平台。

articles.title: Protenix-v2: Broadening the Reach of Structure Prediction and Biomolecular Design
articles.summary: Advances in biomolecular modeling have broadened the range of problems addressable by structure prediction and design models. Here, we present results from Protenix-v2, a system spanning high-accuracy structure prediction and biomolecular design. On the structure prediction side, Protenix-v2 achieves antibody-antigen success rates with up to 13-point gains over Protenix-v1, while 5-seed performance surpasses previous 1000-seed results. On the design side, Protenix-v2 demonstrates a 100% target-l
articles.chinese_summary: Protenix-v2系统在蛋白质结构预测和生物分子设计领域取得突破，抗体-抗原预测成功率较前代提升13个百分点，设计成功率高达100%。该技术对创新抗体药物开发和靶向治疗设计具有重要价值，直接推动生物医药研发进程。

articles.title: Leveraging quadplexed digital PCR to characterize gene therapy vectors
articles.summary: Currently there is a lack of high-throughput, low material-input methods to screen early-stage product quality of viral and non-viral gene therapy products. Here we propose using multiplex droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) to screen and characterize vector sequences. We describe the adaptation of a Poisson-multinomial model to quantitate integrity of any combination of 4 targets in multiplexed ddPCR. We show the success and limitations of model employment and provide some suggested best practices.
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了四重微滴数字PCR技术，用于高通量检测基因治疗载体的序列完整性。通过建立泊松-多项式模型，可同时定量分析4个靶点，为早期基因治疗产品的质量控制提供了低样本量、高效率的解决方案。

articles.title: A Real Time Quaking Induced Conversion (RT-QuIC) Assay for Detection of Misfolded Insulin Protein
articles.summary: Protein misfolding plays a critical role in aging and disease, yet the involvement of specif-ic proteins in metabolic dysfunction is still poorly understood. Here, we report studies on the development of a Real-time Quaking-Induced Conversion (RT-QuIC) assay to detect misfolded insulin, a peptide hormone required for blood glucose regulation. Although RT-QuIC assays were originally designed to amplify misfolded prion proteins implicated in neurodegeneration, we adapted the method to monitor conf
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了实时震动诱导转化(RT-QuIC)检测方法用于监测错误折叠胰岛素。该方法源自神经退行性疾病中朊病毒检测技术，现成功应用于代谢疾病领域，为糖尿病等疾病的早期诊断提供了新型检测工具，在创新诊断技术开发方面具有重要价值。

articles.title: Learning latent conformational landscapes encoded in cryo-EM
articles.summary: Proteins exist as a continuum of conformational states, millions of snapshots of which are captured in every cryo-EM experiment. Current analysis reduces these snapshots to static density maps or discrete classes, discarding the dynamics encoded in the data. Continuous latent-space methods offer a promising alternative, yet whether their learned representations are physically grounded remains unresolved. Here, we show that cryo-EM data can be organized into a probabilistic conformational landsca
articles.chinese_summary: 该研究开发了一种从冷冻电镜数据中学习蛋白质连续构象景观的潜在空间方法。通过保留数据中编码的动态信息，突破了传统静态密度图分析的局限。这项基础技术虽不直接涉及药物开发，但对理解蛋白质功能机制具有重要价值，可能间接支持创新药靶点发现和生物制造过程中的酶工程优化。

articles.title: "Editing the conserved IPA1-TB1 regulatory module reshapes plant architecture and enhances tillering in wheat
articles.summary: Plant architecture is a major determinant of yield potential in cereal crops, where tiller number directly influences spike production and grain yield. The transcriptional regulators Ideal Plant Architecture 1 (IPA1) and Teosinte Branched1 (TB1) constitute a conserved genetic module controlling axillary bud activity and branching in grasses; however, their functional contribution to wheat architecture remains largely unexplored. Here, we employed CRISPR/Cas9-mediated genome editing to investigat
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过CRISPR/Cas9基因组编辑技术，探索IPA1-TB1调控模块在小麦株型构建中的作用。该保守模块控制禾本科植物的分蘖行为，编辑后可重塑小麦株型并增强分蘖能力。研究虽聚焦作物育种，但与基因治疗等技术原理相通，在生物技术应用层面具有一定参考价值。

articles.title: Opinion: Sports betting is creating a twofold public health crisis for some young men
articles.summary: “Even if not everybody is losing a ton of money right now, you're creating this culture of large numbers of gamblers,” Isaac Rose-Berman says on the First Opinion Podcast.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文讨论体育博彩在年轻男性中引发的双重公共卫生危机，涉及赌博文化对心理健康和社会福祉的影响。虽不直接涉及创新药或生物制造，但与公共健康领域的成瘾行为和预防策略相关。

articles.title: Opinion: What STAT readers think about nutrition education in med school
articles.summary: “Is ‘lack of education’ really what we think the problem is in prevention care?” a STAT reader asks.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文讨论医学教育中营养学培训的缺失问题，涉及预防性医疗保健领域。虽然不直接涉及创新药物或生物制造技术，但与公共卫生和精准医疗中的疾病预防理念相关，属于大健康范畴的医疗体系优化议题。

articles.title: In-cell structural insights into fungal ER stress responses
articles.summary: Approximately a third of a cell's proteome is folded in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). The accumulation of misfolded proteins in the ER results in ER stress. The unfolded protein response (UPR) has evolved to attenuate ER stress by increasing the cell's folding capacity and reducing the folding load in the ER. In metazoans, the latter is notably achieved through mRNA translation inhibition. However, S. cerevisiae lacks the corresponding pathways, and its reliance on translational downregulation
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过细胞内结构分析揭示真菌内质网应激反应机制，重点关注未折叠蛋白反应途径。虽然涉及蛋白质折叠质量控制这一生物制造基础过程，但主要聚焦基础细胞生物学机制，与创新药和健康领域的直接关联有限。

articles.title: Targeted sequencing of mutations via RNA-templated gap filling of oligonucleotides for single-cell RNA-seq
articles.summary: We describe a method for targeted sequencing of expressed mutations in single cells. The approach exploits the reverse transcriptase and nick translation activities of the Bst DNA polymerase (Full Length) from Bacillus stearothermophilus (BstFL) to perform an RNA-templated gap filling and ligation between flanking probes. Integrated with probe-based single cell RNAseq workflows, it enables simultaneous whole transcriptomic and multiplexed mutation profiling from the same cell, overcoming key lim

articles.title: Thiol methyltransferase METTL7B coordinates lipid metabolism and promotes tumor progression in pancreatic cancer
articles.summary: Dysregulated lipid metabolism drives cancer progression, yet the molecular mechanisms linking lipid accumulation to pancreatic cancer remain poorly understood. Here, we identify methyltransferase-like 7B (METTL7B) as a key regulator of lipid metabolism and tumor progression in pancreatic cancer. Integrated analysis of large-scale transcriptomic datasets revealed that METTL7B is upregulated in pancreatic cancer compared with normal tissues, and elevated METTL7B expression is associated with poor

articles.title: Cracking the Code for a Successful Partnership with a CDMO
articles.summary: How can you ensure that you’ve selected the right contract design and manufacturing organization? We’re going to tell you how in this webinar sponsored by Velentium.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文聚焦如何选择合适的合同研发生产组织(CDMO)，探讨建立成功合作伙伴关系的关键要素。内容涉及生物制造过程中的外包策略和质量管控，为创新药开发企业提供生物生产环节的专业指导。

articles.title: STAT+: A new trick for old science, and biotech VCs’ scrambled playbook
articles.summary: CAR-T promise in autoimmunity, GSK's goodbye to leucovorin, and more biotech news
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨CAR-T疗法在自身免疫疾病领域的新应用前景，同时涉及生物科技风投策略调整及制药公司产品线变动。核心聚焦创新疗法临床转化与生物技术投资动态，与创新药领域高度相关。

articles.title: STAT+: Replimune skin cancer drug that became FDA flashpoint is rejected again
articles.summary: A cancer drug candidate that, rightly or wrongly, became a flashpoint at FDA, fails on a second try at approval.
articles.chinese_summary: Replimune公司皮肤癌候选药物在FDA审批中再次被拒，该药物此前已成为监管争议焦点。这一事件凸显了创新肿瘤疗法在监管审批过程中的挑战，对癌症治疗领域的药物开发具有重要参考价值。

articles.title: Drugs from a Text Prompt, Wegovy Pill Competition Dampens Lilly’s Surge
articles.summary:
In this episode of GEN's Touching Base, editors discuss a new wave of agentic AI transforming the modern lab, multiple billion-dollar-plus acquisitions, and the dynamic obesity market.
The post Drugs from a Text Prompt, Wegovy Pill Competition Dampens Lilly’s Surge appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 本期GEN节目讨论了三项前沿进展：能够根据文本提示生成药物的新型AI系统正在变革实验室研究；多笔超十亿美元的生物医药并购交易；以及诺和诺德口服版Wegovy对礼来肥胖药物市场的竞争影响。内容聚焦AI驱动的药物研发创新和肥胖治疗市场动态。

articles.title: Dual Recognition Drives Site-Directed G-Quadruplex Stabilization: Exploring Oligonucleotide Design in G4 Ligand-Oligonucleotide Conjugates
articles.summary: G-quadruplex (G4) DNA structures are increasingly recognized for their roles in key cellular processes, including transcriptional regulation and genome stability, making them attractive therapeutic targets. Selective recognition of individual G4s remains challenging due to the high structural similarity among human G4 motifs. The G4 Ligand-conjugated Oligonucleotide strategy addresses this need by combining the G4-binding capabilities of small-molecule G4- ligands with the sequence specificity o
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种G4配体-寡核苷酸偶联策略，通过小分子配体与序列特异性寡核苷酸的结合，实现对特定G-四链体结构的定向稳定。该技术为解决G-四链体选择性识别难题提供了新方案，在创新药物开发（特别是靶向转录调控和基因组稳定的疗法）领域具有重要应用价值。

articles.title: Author Correction: Multi-omic profiling reveals age-related immune dynamics in healthy adults
articles.summary: Nature, Published online: 10 April 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10484-wAuthor Correction: Multi-omic profiling reveals age-related immune dynamics in healthy adults
articles.chinese_summary: 本文通过多组学分析揭示了健康成人体内与年龄相关的免疫动态变化，为理解免疫系统衰老机制提供了重要数据。研究结果对精准医学和公共健康领域具有显著价值，可为年龄相关疾病的预防和诊疗策略提供科学依据。

articles.title: Cancer Drug Shortfalls Tied to How BET Inhibitors Hit BRD2 and BRD4 Differently
articles.summary:
Using rapid protein degradation, chemogenomics, and super‑resolution microscopy in mouse embryonic stem cells, the team dissected the distinct contributions of BRD2 and BRD4 to transcription.
The post Cancer Drug Shortfalls Tied to How BET Inhibitors Hit BRD2 and BRD4 Differently appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 研究团队通过快速蛋白质降解、化学基因组学及超分辨率显微镜技术，在小鼠胚胎干细胞中揭示了BRD2和BRD4在转录调控中的不同作用。该发现解释了现有BET抑制剂类抗癌药物疗效不足的原因，为开发更精准的靶向药物提供了关键机制依据。

articles.title: The Trends Shaping the Medtech CMO Market
articles.summary: L.E.K. Consultants will discuss the major forces shaping the CMO market in this upcoming webinar hosted by MD+DI and sponsored by Epicor.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨医疗技术合同制造组织(CMO)市场的发展趋势，属于生物制造领域。虽然聚焦医疗器械而非创新药，但涉及合同制造、生产流程优化等生物制造核心环节，与CDMO模式高度相关。

articles.title: Opinion: What public health can learn from the MAHA movement
articles.summary: “What MAHA has built, in a relatively short time, is social capital,” writes Monica L. Wang.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨公共卫生领域可从MAHA运动学习的经验，强调社会资本在促进社区健康中的重要作用。文章虽未直接涉及创新药或生物制造技术，但对大健康领域的公共卫生策略和社区健康干预具有参考价值。

articles.title: Cryo-EM Structural Biology Facility Opened in San Diego by FairJourney Bio
articles.summary:
The cryo-EM technology is designed to provide detailed insights across the R&D value chain—from epitope mapping and hit generation to structure-guided lead optimization and candidate selection.
The post Cryo-EM Structural Biology Facility Opened in San Diego by FairJourney Bio appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: FairJourney Bio在圣地亚哥开设冷冻电镜结构生物学设施，该技术可为研发价值链提供从表位定位、先导化合物发现到结构引导的候选药物优化的全程支持。这一平台将显著提升生物制药研发效率，对生物制造工艺开发具有重要价值。

articles.title: First Detailed Insight into Bornavirus Nucleoprotein–RNA Complex Reveals Unique Assembly
articles.summary:
Cryo-EM study reveals the first detailed structure of the Bornavirus nucleoprotein–RNA complex, uncovering unique RNA binding and assembly mechanisms that advance understanding of viral replication and antiviral targets.
The post First Detailed Insight into Bornavirus Nucleoprotein–RNA Complex Reveals Unique Assembly appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 冷冻电镜研究首次揭示了博尔纳病毒核蛋白-RNA复合物的精细结构，发现了独特的RNA结合和组装机制。这一发现推进了对病毒复制机制的理解，为开发抗病毒药物提供了新的潜在靶点，对创新药物研发具有重要价值。

articles.title: Epigenetics at Birth Links Microbiome to Neurodevelopment, Potentially ASD and ADHD
articles.summary:
Researchers have found that the human gut microbiome and epigenetics are intertwined, and that both contribute to early life neurodevelopment, and potentially to the development of ASD and ADHD. 
The post Epigenetics at Birth Links Microbiome to Neurodevelopment, Potentially ASD and ADHD appeared first on GEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
articles.chinese_summary: 研究发现人类肠道微生物组与表观遗传学在出生时即相互关联，共同影响早期神经发育，并可能与自闭症谱系障碍(ASD)和注意力缺陷多动障碍(ADHD)的发生有关。这项研究为大健康领域的精准医疗和公共健康提供了新见解。

articles.title: 2026 Medical Device Manufacturing Outlook: Optimism Grows Despite Lingering Uncertainty
articles.summary: The Q1 2026 Manufacturing Pulse Study reveals optimism in manufacturing, led by medical and aerospace growth, despite ongoing challenges like inflation, labor shortages, and supply chain risks.
articles.chinese_summary: 2026年第一季度制造业脉搏研究显示，医疗设备和航空航天领域引领制造业乐观情绪增长。尽管面临通胀、劳动力短缺和供应链风险等持续挑战，但医疗制造领域仍表现出较强韧性。

articles.title: RPL38 controls 60S ribosomal subunit homeostasis to regulate start-codon stringency and frame selection during C9ORF72 RAN translation
articles.summary: Translation initiation depends on stringent start-codon recognition, yet how ribosomal states modulate initiation stringency remains incompletely defined. Repeat-associated non-AUG (RAN) translation is a non-canonical initiation pathway that generates toxic dipeptide repeat proteins in C9ORF72-associated frontotemporal dementia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (FTD/ALS). Here, we performed a dual-luciferase reporter-based siRNA screen to identify factors that differentially regulate canonical A
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过siRNA筛选发现核糖体蛋白RPL38通过调控60S核糖体亚基稳态，影响C9ORF72基因中重复序列的非AUG翻译过程。该机制揭示了核糖体状态如何调节翻译起始严格性，为FTD/ALS等神经退行性疾病中毒性蛋白产生提供了新见解，但对创新药、生物制造或大健康的直接应用有限。

articles.title: Retractable Technologies Cuts Jobs to Save $2.2M & Focus on Domestic Production
articles.summary: Retractable Technologies is cutting 16% of its workforce to save $2.2 million annually, strengthen domestic production, and reduce reliance on Chinese imports.
articles.chinese_summary: Retractable Technologies裁员16%以节省220万美元年度开支，重点加强国内生产并减少对中国进口的依赖。该举措主要涉及医疗器械生产优化，与生物制造领域的供应链本土化相关，但与创新药研发和大健康领域直接关联度较低。

articles.title: Pulse Biosciences hires Liane Teplitsky as COO
articles.summary: The appointment gives a former Abbott leader oversight of efforts to bring a pulsed field ablation device to market.
articles.chinese_summary: Pulse Biosciences任命前雅培高管Liane Teplitsky为首席运营官，负责推动脉冲场消融设备上市。该设备用于治疗心律失常，属于医疗器械领域，与创新药和生物制造直接关联度较低，但属于大健康范畴的医疗技术应用。

articles.title: Stryker is fully operational after cyberattack
articles.summary: The company disclosed that it expects a material impact on first-quarter financial results. However, it does not expect an effect on full-year results.
articles.chinese_summary: 史赛克公司宣布在遭受网络攻击后已全面恢复运营，预计将对第一季度财务产生实质性影响，但不影响全年业绩。作为医疗器械制造商，该事件间接关联生物制造领域的安全运营问题。

articles.title: Opinion: I’m a MAHA activist. I went into the public health lion’s den — and it changed how I think
articles.summary: “In my most honest of moments, what I want from the medical community is the chance to trust it again,” a MAHA advocate writes.
articles.chinese_summary: 文章探讨MAHA活动家与公共卫生系统的互动经历，聚焦医患信任重建议题。虽涉及公共卫生领域，但未直接讨论创新药研发、生物制造技术或精准医疗等具体科技内容，主要关注医疗体系的社会人文层面。

articles.title: STAT+: GSK says goodbye to leucovorin (again)
articles.summary: A revised ACIP charter, sports betting and gambling addiction, and other health news from Morning Rounds
articles.chinese_summary: GSK再次停止生产甲酰四氢叶酸(leucovorin)，同时涉及修订ACIP章程、体育博彩与赌博成瘾等公共卫生话题。文章主要关注药品市场动态和公共卫生政策，与创新药研发和生物制造直接关联度较低，属于大健康领域的医药市场与公共卫生范畴。

articles.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about cheap generic obesity drugs in India, high demand for estrogen patches and more
articles.summary: And more pharmaceutical news from the Pharmalot campus via the Pharmalittle newsletter
articles.chinese_summary: 本文报道印度廉价仿制肥胖药物、雌激素贴片需求激增等医药行业动态。内容涉及公共卫生领域的药物可及性问题，但与创新药研发、生物制造技术关联较弱，主要反映大健康市场的需求变化和药品供应情况。

articles.title: Trump administration admits a glaring error in its accusations about New York health care fraud
articles.summary: The Trump administration this week acknowledged it made a significant error in figures it used to help justify a fraud probe into New York’s Medicaid program
articles.chinese_summary: 特朗普政府承认在指控纽约医疗欺诈案件中使用错误数据。此事涉及医疗补助计划(Medicaid)调查，主要反映政府监管与公共卫生政策执行问题，与创新药和生物制造领域无直接关联。

articles.title: Neuron-specific epigenetic repression of Cdk5 impairs hippocampal-dependent memory in male and female mice
articles.summary: Biological sex regulates fundamental neurobiology, as well as the etiology and prevalence of neuropsychiatric disorders. Cyclin-dependent kinase 5 (Cdk5) is a neuronally enriched kinase that regulates synaptic plasticity, neuronal homeostasis, and hippocampal-dependent memory. While Cdk5 protein activity is necessary and sufficient to promote memory in male rodents, its role in females and its gene regulation in either sex remain poorly understood. In males, Cdk5 protein inhibition impairs fear
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过神经元特异性表观遗传抑制Cdk5，揭示了该激酶在雄性和雌性小鼠海马依赖性记忆中的关键作用。研究发现Cdk5蛋白活性在雄性啮齿类动物中足以促进记忆形成，但其在雌性中的作用及基因调控机制尚不明确，为理解性别差异在神经精神疾病中的生物学基础提供了新见解。

articles.title: Impact of Fluorophore and Epitope Position on Destabilized Reporter Performance in C. elegans
articles.summary: Determining spatial and temporal gene expression is crucial for understanding animal development and physiology. Promoter reporters are powerful tools used to dissect how cis-regulatory elements and trans-acting factors control gene expression. Many fluorescent proteins used in promoter reporters, however, have long half-lives (>24 hr) which limit the study of dynamic expression. Destabilizing sequences like PEST reduce the half-life of reporter proteins to provide a more representative readout
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过PEST不稳定序列优化荧光报告蛋白的半衰期，提升对线虫基因表达动态监测的准确性。虽未直接涉及创新药或生物制造，但为发育生物学研究提供了改进工具，间接支持精准医学的基础研究。

articles.title: How sports betting apps hook users

articles.title: mRNA stability in response to m6A placement is linked to cell identity in planarians
articles.summary: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is a widespread internal modification of eukaryotic mRNA that influences transcript fate, including mRNA stability and cell-type-specific gene expression. articles.title: Molecular Engineering of Functional DNA Molecules toward Targeted Protein Degradation.
articles.summary: ConspectusPrecise manipulation of the cellular proteome is a central challenge in biomedicine. Targeted protein degradation (TPD) has emerged as a transformative therapeutic strategy, capable of directly eliminating disease-causing proteins beyond the reach of traditional inhibition. However, its broad application is fundamentally constrained by the severe scarcity of high-affinity, cell-permeable ligands for most disease-relevant proteins. To bridge this critical ligand gap, synthetic DNA has been engineered to create a programmable, multifunctional core material for designing degraders. DNA's inherent biocompatibility, precise molecular programmability, and versatile functionalization render it an exceptionally flexible substrate for constructing sophisticated degradation systems.In this
articles.chinese_summary: 本文探讨功能DNA分子的分子工程在靶向蛋白降解中的应用。DNA凭借其生物相容性、可编程性和多功能性，成为设计降解系统的理想材料，为解决传统疗法难以靶向的疾病蛋白提供了创新策略，属于创新药领域的前沿研究。

articles.summary: Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has transformed the treatment landscape for B-cell malignancies, particularly in relapsed and refractory leukemia. However, conventional CAR constructs targeting CD19 or CD20 often result in off-tumor toxicity due to shared antigen expression on healthy B-cells. CD179a, a novel leukemia-associated antigen with limited expression on normal tissues, presents a promising alternative target for safer and more specific immunotherapy. A 5th-generation CAR construct targeting CD179a was engineered and transfected into human T-cells to assess its antileukemic efficacy. articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了靶向CD179a的第五代CAR-T细胞，在B细胞恶性肿瘤临床前模型中展现出强大且持久的抗肿瘤活性。CD179a作为新型白血病相关抗原可减少对正常组织的毒性，为更安全的免疫治疗提供新策略。

articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了TCXpress高通量平台，可无需测序直接从单细胞克隆表达性TCR，用于识别肿瘤突变产生的新抗原特异性T细胞受体。该技术为开发新型TCR-T细胞免疫疗法提供了重要工具，尤其适用于针对个体化肿瘤新抗原的精准免疫治疗。

articles.title: CGDock: Curvature-Aware Geometric Flow Framework for Protein-Ligand Docking.
articles.summary: Accurately predicting the conformation of small-molecule ligands to protein targets is a critical step in drug discovery and therapeutic development. Although deep learning has enabled substantial advances in molecular docking, many existing frameworks still overlook essential local geometric features when representing proteins and ligands. This limitation compromises the precision of pocket identification and diminishes the reliability of the predicted binding poses. Additionally, numerous pocket prediction modules rely on external tools or fixed thresholds to delineate candidate binding regions, which lack adaptability and constrain the overall efficiency. To address this limitation, we present CGDock, an end-to-end protein-ligand docking framework that is based on curvature-aware geomet
articles.chinese_summary: CGDock提出基于曲率感知几何流的蛋白质-配体对接框架，通过捕捉局部几何特征提升结合位点识别精度和结合构象预测可靠性。该端到端深度学习模型无需外部工具即可实现口袋预测，显著推进药物发现中关键分子对接环节的精准度与效率。

Multispecific therapeutics, which combine variable regions targeting two or more antigens, offer potential advantages such as enhanced efficacy, broader target modulation, and reduced side effects. This study aimed to identify and characterize bispecific, VHH-based antibodies simultaneously targeting IL-6 and IL-17A-two key cytokines involved in autoimmune and chronic inflammatory conditions. Methods: A phage display screening was conducted using llama-derived VHH libraries to select binders against human IL-6 and IL-17A. Binding affinities of individual VHHs and assembled bispecific constructs were asse
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种同时靶向IL-6和IL-17A的双特异性VHH抗体，用于治疗自身免疫和慢性炎症疾病。通过噬菌体展示筛选骆驼源VHH库，评估结合亲和力，展示了多特异性疗法在复杂炎症疾病中的治疗潜力。

articles.title: Antibody-Drug Conjugates Reshape the Landscape of Cancer Therapy: Evolution, Challenges and Future Perspectives from the Concept of "Magic Bullet" to Clinical Application.
articles.chinese_summary: 本文系统回顾抗体偶联药物从'魔法子弹'概念到临床应用的演进历程，探讨其如何重塑癌症治疗格局。文章分析ADC技术发展中的挑战与未来前景，涉及靶向递送、药物偶联等生物制药核心技术，对创新药研发具有重要参考价值。

articles.title: Targeted delivery of RNA using synthetic bacterial spores.
articles.summary: RNA therapy, which includes delivery of mRNA or siRNA, shows promise for treating various diseases, but difficulties in targeting specific cell types and low efficiency of loading RNA into nanoparticles remain hurdles to achieving widespread use. Previously, we reported the assembly of biocompatible synthetic bacterial spore-like particles, termed "SSHELs", which are built atop a porous silica core encased in a lipid bilayer and two bacterial proteins that form a stable proteinaceous surface that may be covalently modified with targeting proteins of interest. Here, we employ micron-scale SSHELs constructed using a fusogenic lipid and decorated with affibodies targeting cell surface HER2 to specifically deliver model mRNA and siRNA molecules specifically to HER2-positive ovarian and breast
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种基于合成细菌孢子的RNA靶向递送系统SSHELs，通过修饰HER2靶向配体实现mRNA/siRNA对卵巢癌和乳腺癌的特异性递送。该技术解决了RNA疗法中细胞靶向性和纳米颗粒装载效率的关键难题，属于创新药物递送平台的重要突破。
articles.journal: Journal of drug delivery science and technology

articles.title: Establishing Komagataella phaffii as a cell factory for efficient production of chondroitin sulfate.
articles.summary: Chondroitin sulfate (CS) is a vital sulfated glycosaminoglycan with essential physiological functions and broad applications in pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals. Commercial CS production currently relies on extraction from animal tissues, which suffers from raw material scarcity, long production cycles, and safety concerns. Here, an efficient microbial platform for de novo biosynthesis of chondroitin sulfate A (CSA) was established in Komagataella phaffii. The chondroitin biosynthetic pathway was first reconstructed and optimized through rearrangement of three heterologous genes and promoter selection, achieving 927 mg/L unsulfated chondroitin. Functional expression of a chondroitin-4-O-sulfotransferase (CHST11) enabled the biosynthesis of 750.5 mg/L CSA with a sulfation degree of 2.6 %.
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究成功构建了毕赤酵母细胞工厂，通过异源重构硫酸软骨素生物合成途径并优化表达系统，实现了750.5 mg/L硫酸软骨素A的从头生物合成。该技术突破了传统动物组织提取法的局限，为医药级硫酸软骨素的可持续生产提供了创新解决方案。

articles.title: De novo biosynthesis of medicarpin in metabolically engineered yeast.
articles.summary: Medicarpin exhibits multiple pharmacological activities, including antitumor and antibacterial effects. However, its extraction from natural plant sources is limited, and chemical synthesis is complex and costly. Therefore, developing an economical, green, and sustainable medicarpin production method is of great significance. In this study, we achieved the de novo synthesis of medicarpin in engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Specifically, we overexpressed and mutated endogenous yeast genes involved in the upstream shikimate pathway and aromatic amino acid biosynthesis pathway, which are essential for flavonoid synthesis. Additionally, we constructed the downstream flavonoid biosynthetic pathway in engineered yeast strains by integrating heterologous genes derived from plants and bacteria
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过代谢工程改造酿酒酵母，实现了药用成分medicarpin的从头生物合成。通过调控上游莽草酸途径和芳香氨基酸生物合成途径，并整合植物/细菌来源的异源基因构建下游黄酮类合成通路，为这种具有抗肿瘤、抗菌活性的天然产物提供了经济绿色的可持续生产方案。

articles.title: In situ rewiring TAMs as annihilators by "Spark-relay" nanoinitiator with flexible reactant ratio for amplifying solid tumor immunotherapy.
articles.summary: Tailoring tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) into the tumoricidal phenotype represents a high-profile strategy for tumor immunotherapy. However, the existing TAMs repolarization strategies are restricted by hostile microenvironmental stress and metabolic compensation, leading to limited anti-tumor phenotype sustainability. Herein, a "Spark-Relay" nanoinitiator (SRN) with flexible S/R reactant ratio was meticulously designed for rewiring TAMs as tumoricidal bioreactor and precisely overcome metabolic compensation. Briefly, SRN reshaped TAMs in situ relying on tissue tropism of macrophage membrane, firstly upregulating their reactive oxygen species (ROS) production via burst release of Spark element and initially shifting the TAMs into the anti-tumoral phenotype, subsequently elevating NO p
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究设计了一种'火花-接力'纳米引发剂，通过调节活性氧和NO的释放，原位重编程肿瘤相关巨噬细胞为杀伤表型，克服肿瘤微环境障碍和代谢补偿，显著增强实体瘤免疫治疗效果。

articles.title: Metabolic Engineering of Rhodotorula toruloides for Biosynthesis of Retinal.
articles.summary: Rapid advancements in biotechnology have enabled biomanufacturing to emerge as a feasible approach for industrial chemical production. By harnessing synthetic biology and metabolic engineering, engineered microbial cell factories can convert renewable resources into valuable chemicals, providing a sustainable alternative to traditional chemical methods. This study focuses on the microbial production of retinal, an important retinoid used in pharmaceuticals, food, and cosmetics. The oleaginous yeast Rhodotorula toruloides NP11 was genetically modified to synthesize retinal by incorporating and optimizing three β-carotene 15,15'-dioxygenase genes from various sources. Several genetic modifications were made to enhance retinal yield, including the overexpression of isopentenyl-diphospha
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究通过代谢工程改造油脂酵母Rhodotorula toruloides，引入β-胡萝卜素双加氧酶基因实现视黄醇的生物合成。该工作展示了利用合成生物学技术构建微生物细胞工厂，将可再生资源转化为高价值化学品，为医药、食品和化妆品行业提供可持续生产方案。

articles.title: Ultra-rapid and high-titer biomanufacturing of trehalose 6-phosphate by an in vitro synthetic biology platform.
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种体外合成生物学平台，用于海藻糖-6-磷酸的超快速、高产量生物制造。该技术通过优化生物合成途径和工艺过程，显著提升了目标产物的生产效率，在生物制造和合成生物学领域具有重要应用价值。

articles.title: Oncolytic Virotherapy and Immunogenic Cell Death: Mechanisms, Platforms, and Clinical Translation.
articles.summary: Oncolytic viruses represent a paradigm-shifting approach to cancer immunotherapy, functioning as in situ vaccines that convert immunologically "cold" tumors into "hot" tumors through induction of immunogenic cell death (ICD). Despite the clinical success of checkpoint inhibitors targeting programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1)/programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) and cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-associated protein 4 (CTLA-4), many patients exhibit primary or acquired resistance due to insufficient tumor immunogenicity and exclusion of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. Oncolytic viruses address this limitation by selectively replicating in tumor cells, inducing robust ICD characterized by four cardinal hallmarks: calreticulin exposure, ATP secretion, HMGB1 release, and type I interferon production. Th
articles.chinese_summary: 溶瘤病毒疗法通过诱导免疫原性细胞死亡，将免疫‘冷’肿瘤转化为‘热’肿瘤，是癌症免疫治疗的突破性方法。文章系统阐述了其作用机制、技术平台及临床转化路径，与创新药开发高度相关，特别是对解决免疫检查点抑制剂耐药问题具有重要意义。

articles.title: Design principles of nanomaterials for cancer immunotherapy: a mechanistic framework across the cancer immunity cycle.
articles.summary: Cancer immunotherapy has revolutionized oncology by harnessing the immune system to eliminate malignant cells, yet its efficacy remains constrained by insufficient antigen presentation, limited T cell infiltration, and the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). Nanotechnology provides strategies to address these barriers by enabling the precise delivery of antigens, adjuvants, cytokines, checkpoint inhibitors, and nucleic acids, while protecting labile cargos and allowing for controlled release. Beyond serving as carriers, nanoparticles can regulate antitumor immunity by enhancing antigen presentation, promoting T cell priming and infiltration, and remodeling the TME. This review outlines key physiological barriers to in vivo nanoparticle delivery and the corresponding engineering
articles.chinese_summary: 本文系统阐述了纳米材料在癌症免疫治疗中的设计原则，通过增强抗原呈递、促进T细胞活化与浸润、重塑肿瘤微环境等机制，克服当前免疫疗法的局限性。纳米载体可实现抗原/佐剂/核酸等药物的精准递送与控释，为创新药物研发提供重要技术平台。

articles.title: ROS Self-Supply Nanoplatform Based on Fenton Catalyst for Chemodynamic and Immunotherapy: Reprogramming Cold Tumor Into Hot Tumor in Cancer Treatment.
articles.summary: The immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME) severely limits the clinical efficacy of immunotherapy, largely due to the prevalence of "cold tumors" with minimal T cell infiltration. To address this, we developed a reactive oxygen species (ROS) self-supplying nanoplatform (HA-PGMC) by in situ growing copper peroxide (CuO2) nanodots and loading glucose oxidase (GOx) within a mil-100 metal-organic framework (MOF). HA-PGMC exploits the catalytic cascade between released Fe2 + and Cu+ ions to generate abundant •OHs (•OH) under acidic and glucose-rich tumor conditions, thereby amplifying oxidative stress. Meanwhile, Cu2 + ions deplete glutathione (GSH), further enhancing ROS accumulation. In vitro studies demonstrate that HA-PGMC induces significant ROS production, GSH deplet
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种ROS自供给纳米平台，通过级联催化反应在肿瘤微环境中大量产生活性氧，同时消耗谷胱甘肽，增强氧化应激。该技术能将免疫抑制型冷肿瘤转化为热肿瘤，显著提升免疫治疗效果，属于创新药物递送系统的前沿探索。

articles.title: An All-in-One Attack: Microneedle-Delivered Bio-Hybrid Nanoagonist for Tumor Immunotherapy.
articles.summary: Standard treatments for oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), including surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy, are often ineffective in preventing recurrence. This challenge is largely attributed to the persistently high recurrence rates driven by the highly immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). Here, we develop a dissolvable gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA-PVA) microneedle patch for localized delivery of a bio-hybrid nanocomplex, MPN@Pg-OMVMel, designed to synergistically eradicate tumors and remodel the TME. The nanocomplex, formed by coating Melanin-containing bacterial outer membrane vesicles from Porphyromonas gingivalis (Pg-OMVMel)with an iron-tannic acid metal-phenolic network (MPN), mediates potent photothermal therapy under 808 nm laser irradiation. Simultaneously, the MPN
articles.chinese_summary: 本研究开发了一种可溶解微针贴片，用于局部递送生物杂交纳米复合物MPN@Pg-OMVMel，通过光热疗法协同消除口腔鳞状细胞癌肿瘤并重塑免疫抑制肿瘤微环境。该技术结合了新型药物递送系统和纳米材料，属于创新药领域的免疫治疗前沿方向。

articles.title: Comparative Evaluation of Engineered Bacteria and Yeast for Oral Delivery of CRISPR/Cas9 Systems in Colon Cancer Therapy.
articles.summary: Colorectal cancer (CRC) poses a serious threat to human health. CRISPR/Cas9 technology offers new therapeutic strategies for the management of this disease, but its oral application is severely hindered by the limitations of suitable delivery systems.
